1.title: Netanyahu needs to hear from America that we don’t like what he’s doing
1.description:

4.title: BREAKING: U.S. Congress passes crippling Russia sanctions bill
4.description:
Today, the U.S. House passed crippling Russia sanctions legislation. It is now on to the President's desk to become law.
 
"Today democracy won. To Vladimir Putin and all of our adverseries: there are consequences for violating international law." - @SenatorShaheen

6.description:

"President Zelenskyy told Members of Congress, 'Ukraine needs this bill.' I hope our colleagues in the House will pass this legislation as soon as they return."

25.title: The Ebola Risk America Can’t Afford to Ignore
25.description:
Senate Foreign Relations Committee Ranking Member @SenatorShaheen sits down with Dr. Craig Spencer, Associate Professor of the Practice of Health Services, Policy and Practice at the Brown University School of Public Health (@BrownPublicHealth) to discuss the threat of the current Ebola virus outbreak, the impact cuts to foreign assistance have had on America's response and what this means for future infectious disease response. 

Dr. Spencer contracted Ebola while working with the nonprofit group Doctors Without Borders in Guinea during the Ebola outbreak there in September 2014.
